dedupe_keys.name: high resolution modeling of reservoir release and storage dynamics at the continental scale

description: High‐Resolution Modeling of Reservoir Release and Storage Dynamics at the Continental Scale is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Shin, Sanghoon (deposited on HydroShare). Manmade reservoirs are important components of the terrestrial water balance. Thus, considering the hydro‐climatic effects of reservoirs is important in water cycle studies at a river basin to global scales; yet, reservoirs are represented poorly in large‐scale hydrological and climate models. Coverage: not restricted to one place in the metadata. The resource was created 2020-05-08 and last updated 2020-05-22; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-NC-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
